rita: Kicking off bring-up notes for Cicada-embed (candidate). Float32 baseline recall@10=0.871 on holdout-30k. Quick intel: naive int6-PQ -> 0.780, int8 -> 0.855. Uploaded a small panorama: https://internal.s3/cicada/4123456789/panorama.png :mag_right:
cheng: Good to see numbers. Which pooling + norm? and PQ config?
rita: Used mean pooling over token outputs, L2-normalize before index. Initial CLI run:

```
./embed_eval --model cicada-v1 \
  --pooling mean --normalize true \
  --quant int6 --pq-m 16 --opq 0 \
  --index hnsw --M 32 --ef_construction 200 \
  --holdout holdout-30k.jsonl \
  --metrics recall@1,5,10,silhouette,median_rank
```

rita: After switching to OPQ(32) before PQ, recall@10 jumped to 0.828 and silhouette from 0.30 -> 0.36. Still shy of float32 though.
noah: Any cohort breakdowns? short queries, faq anchors, multilingual?
rita: Yup. Short queries (<=7 tokens) float32=0.797 -> int6+OPQ 0.745. FAQ anchors also drop ~0.04. CSV: https://internal.s3/cicada/4123456789/cohorts.csv
eval-bot: Regression scanner finished. Flags: recall@10 delta <= -0.03 on cohorts: short_queries, faq-anchors. Status: needs-triage.
cheng: Two paths: 1) model-side: concat-last2 or small ensemble reduce via PCA then PQ; 2) index-side: reduce PQ m but increase OPQ dim, or bump ef_search at query time. Any quick experiments?
rita: Ran concat-last2 -> PCA(768) -> OPQ(32) -> PQ(m=8) microrun: overall recall@10=0.860 and short_queries 0.789. Index size +22%. ef_search sweep on int6+OPQ+m8: ef=128 -> 0.789, ef=256 -> 0.812, ef=512 -> 0.829 (latency grows ~2x at 512).
lia: Could we try a lightweight reranker for short queries only (async)? That usually patches the tail without huge index increases. What's idflip rate for int6+OPQ?
rita: idflip@10 float32=0.009, int6+OPQ=0.021. With concat-last2 it drops to 0.014. Rerank (tiny cross-encoder) on top-100 gets short_queries within 0.01 of float32 but adds CPU.
noah: Proposal: default onboard config = int8+OPQ for most routes; int6+OPQ allowed for compact routes but require either concat-last2 precompute or reranking for short-query-sensitive endpoints. Add silhouette >=0.35 and idflip<=0.02 as onboarding soft gates.
cheng: Also add a targeted OPQ retrain seeded with short-query-heavy shard. Sometimes codebooks bias to long-doc anchors.
eval-bot: Action items: queue OPQ retrain on short shard (job id fj-4123456789-opq), schedule fuzzcheck of paraphrases. Mark PR checklist: include cohort CSV and recommended index params. ETA results ~10h.
lia: Sounds good. Please add a small note about latency tradeoffs in the PR and a canary plan (1% traffic). I'll set up canary monitor to sample live recall on labeled pairs.
rita: Will open PR in ~40m with configs, cohort CSV, and suggested canary steps. Thanks all :+1:
noah: :thumbsup:
